gr-xendit-7813420003.d:
Xendit is the financial technology platform built for businesses that move fast. We give companies one unified platform for payment acceptance, payouts, treasury and financial services, replacing fragmented local integrations with a single infrastructure layer. We serve businesses of every size, from high-growth startups to global enterprises, processing high-volume transactions across Southeast Asia and beyond, with more markets on our global expansion roadmap.

About the Job

You are looking for a challenge, eager for a fast-paced startup environment that will push you out of your comfort zone, where learning happens. Most importantly, you’re a problem solver with exquisite attention to detail , unafraid to get technical to understand the root cause of an issue.

As a Financial Operations Associate, you will be part of the Financial Operations team responsible for ensuring the seamless flow of funds for the countless transactions happening on the Xendit platform daily. This role will be part of a new subteam being formed within FinOps to own reconciliations across the entire organisation, driving high impact across the region by ensuring all funds are moving as they should and we have full oversight over all movements.

If you can be accurate and detail-oriented under pressure, are always reliable, collaborative, and love the dynamic environment of operations, we want to hear from you. Bonus points for those who love challenging the status quo.

Minimum Qualifications

• Graduate of Management, Accounting, Finance, or a similar course, and 1-3 years of relevant experience in a start-up/fast paced environment or within the payments, fintech, or financial services spaces
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
• You are detail oriented, can see patterns in data/information or notice when something is amiss

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in or dealing with banks or large financial institutions, with specialized work on finance, payment and reconciliations
• You have the initiative to continually ask questions and look for answers
• You have a discerning ability to prioritize workload in line with tight deadlines and work effectively under pressure
• You are a team player and communicate well with internal and external stakeholders
• You have great ownership mentality and have proven you can push towards a goal by yourself
• You pick up new skills quickly using a combination of self-exploration and relationship building
• You are a creative thinker who considers problems from a customer perspective while being pragmatic and solutions oriented when solving them
• You have fun in learning and always seeking to improve
• Working experience on reconciliation tools and SQL

Responsibilities

Own & execute reconciliations for Xendit’s day-to-day financial operations

• Own the reconciliation process for all Xendit products across the region, ensuring that all funds are moving as expected and Xendit does not have any exposure or incorrect transactions
• Work with the product teams on automating recons across products and the region to ensure no gaps in the process and Xendit is protected against money loss
• Have the opportunity to learn how Xendit operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders

• Solve for unreconciled transactions by working with product, partnerships and finance to identify and resolve root causes

Set up recons for any new products

• As new products are launched and we expand to new markets, set up and own the reconciliation processes to ensure that at all points, Xendit recons are operating at best in class standards

Do whatever it takes to make Xendit succeed

About the Role

You will be part of the Media Relations team, which plays a key role in managing the company’s relationship with the media. Our core responsibilities include monitoring news coverage, drafting press materials, and coordinating with journalists to ensure accurate and positive representation of the company.

As an intern, you will support these day-to-day activities and work closely with team members to gain practical experience in media engagement and corporate storytelling

What You Will Do

• Support daily media monitoring and prepare news summaries for internal use.
• Assist in drafting and proofreading press releases, media advisories, and briefing documents.
• Help coordinate media engagement activities, including events, interviews, and press conferences.
• Maintain and update media contact databases.
• Assist with reporting on media coverage and campaign performance.
• Provide administrative and logistical support to the Media Relations function as needed.

What You Will Need

• Final-year student degree in Communications, Media, International Relations, Journalism, or a related field.
• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken, with the ability to draft various communication materials (e.g., press releases, briefing documents, editorial summaries).
• Demonstrated interest in corporate communications, public affairs, and media relations, prior internship experience in a PR agency, newsroom, corporate communications, or event management is an advantage.
• Familiarity with social media monitoring tools and media database platforms.
• Strong writing skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, particularly in journalistic style, will be a plus.
• Available for 3-months internship (Full Time)

About the Team

Our Media Relations team manages GoTo’s relationship with the media and supports the company’s corporate reputation and communications initiatives. The team works closely with internal stakeholders and external media partners to drive effective and timely communications.

As a Media Relations Intern, you’ll get hands-on exposure to media monitoring, research, media engagement, communications materials, and media events in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

Network Management Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Job Purpose

The Network Management Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for hands-on engineering and operations of LAN, WAN, internet, and voice/UC services in the Indonesia environment. The role executes complex changes, leads L2/L3 incident resolution, and mentors Analysts on network practices.

Key responsibilities

Network Operations:
• Perform fault detection, alerting, and corrective action on LAN/WAN and internet connectivity.
• Monitor availability and performance using network management tools; tune thresholds and baselines.
• Administer and support Move/Add/Change (MAC) on network components.
• Manage network component configuration versioning and golden-config baselines.
• Provide hand-and-feet support for network component deployment when required.

Coordination & Improvement:
• Coordinate / oversee Kyndryl, telco, and other 3P vendors on assigned LAN/WAN/voice activities; validate vendor work products.
• Drive RCA on complex incidents; mentor Analysts and contribute to runbook quality.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of hands-on enterprise networking experience covering LAN/WAN, routing, switching, internet, and voice/UC.
• Working knowledge of Cisco / Fortinet / Aruba platforms, SD-WAN, and voice/UC environments (PABX, Teams Phone, or equivalent).
• Experience with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, NetBrain).
• Familiar with ITIL incident, problem, and change management.
• Relevant certifications (CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, ITIL v4 Foundation) preferred.
• Strong communication in Bahasa Indonesia; working-level English sufficient for documentation, ticket handling, and coordination with regional/3P teams.
